title: ST-VQA Scene Text Visual Question Answering Benchmark Protocol

nodes.label:
Seven Diverse Vision Sources Pooling
Pools Images from COCO, Visual Genome, ICDAR, ImageNet, etc.
Curates Authentic Scenes with Natural Incidental Text

Text-Bearing Scene Image Filtering
Applies Text Detectors & Human Verification to Filter Incidental Text
Selects 23,038 Complex Images with Legible Signage & Labels

Crowdsourced VQA Authoring
Crowdsource Workers Author Questions Dependent on Scene Text
Questions Cannot Be Answered Without Reading Scene Typography

Text Grounding & Answer Verification
Verifies Question Answers Grounded in Detected Scene Words
Associates Target Answers with Bounding Box Coordinates

Independent Multi-Worker QA Validation
Independent Annotators Answer Questions to Verify Consistency
Filters Ambiguous, Ill-Posed or Hallucinatory Questions

Data Partitioning & Split Stratification
Partitions Data into Standard Train, Validation & Test Reserves
Ensures No Scene Leaks between Evaluation and Training Sets

Three Evaluation Task Regimes
Defines Task 1 (Strong Lexicon), Task 2 (Weak Lexicon) & Task 3 (Open Dict)
Profiles Models across Varying Levels of Dictionary Guidance

ST-VQA Frozen Release (31,791 QA Pairs)
Freezes 31,791 Validated VQA Pairs across 23,038 Natural Images
ICDAR Official Scene Text Visual QA Competition Benchmark

Multimodal Image & Question Input Assembly
Feeds Natural Image with Text Question to Vision-Language Model
Zero-Shot Prompting Protocol with Open Text Completion

Lexicon Constraint Application
Applies Strong (100-word per image) or Weak (Full dataset) Lexicon
Restricts Decoding Space According to Target Task Setting

Multimodal Scene Text Reading
VLM Localizes and Transcribes Incidental Text Characters
Processes Diverse Orientations, Curved Geometries & Lighting

Predicted Answer Generation
Generates Predicted Answer String Directly from Text Reading
Outputs Short Alphanumeric Tokens Corresponding to Scene Signs

Normalized Levenshtein Similarity (NLS)
Computes NLS = 1 - min(1, EditDistance(P, G) / len(G))
Rewards Near-Miss Character Matches While Penalizing Errors

Average Normalized Levenshtein Similarity (ANLS)
Reports Official ANLS Metric across All 3 Evaluation Tasks
Comprehensive Standard for Incidental Scene Text Visual QA
